ends.note: 10 ft alley printed ALLEY runs north from Richmond (opposite Moore Alley) and stops at the Cincinnati Dental College wall; does not reach West Court

notes: Streets east and west of Central Avenue do not line up, so Central has separate T-junctions for each side. West Court Street west of Central (printed COURT ST., 60 ft, centre y 1755, from sheet 53) is opposite Grandin Alley (10 ft, centre 1757), which runs east into block 2; West Court east of Central (66 ft) is at y 2246. Richmond west of Central (60 ft) is centred at y 2760 and Richmond east of Central (24'4" printed, lines 2777/2862) at 2820. West 9th west of Central (60 ft) is at y 3660 and east of Central (66 ft) at 3415. West 8th west of Central has its north line at y 4471, so its centre (about 4578) falls just off the bottom of the paper (4572) and is not recorded; Central/West 8th on sheet 53 covers it. Charles Street and Genesee Street enter Central from the east, Elizabeth Street from the west. Plum jogs at Genesee: north of Genesee the N-S street is printed W. CENTRAL PARKWAY (W. PLUM), 55 ft, west line x 1746, centre about 1850 (main at 1855-1871; the main and the 55 ft width disagree by about 15 px). South of Genesee, Plum Street is 66 ft, centred at x 2007. The E-W parkway (printed W. CENTRAL PARKWAY, with (W. N. CANAL) and (W. S. CANAL) for the old canal streets) runs from about y 880 to 1392 and opens at its west end into the open space north of Genesee between the N-S parkway and Plum, so no single junction point is recorded there; its crossing with Elm (block lines y 854/1383) is recorded. Block 2's unnamed 10 ft N-S alley at x 888 (printed ALLEY) runs from Genesee to West Court. Grandin Alley jogs at it: the west part (Central to x 888) is centred at y 1757, the east part (x 888 to White Alley) at 1823. Two T-junctions are recorded on the '' alley. WHITE and ALLEY are printed separately along the alley at x ~1556-1560; it runs from Genesee across West Court to Richmond and is treated as White Alley throughout. Grandin Alley east of Plum (y ~1846) runs from Plum to Elm. The unnamed 10 ft alley at x ~920 runs from Richmond to 9th (between the Goodall Bldg and the Central Christian Church). MOORE and ALLEY are printed separately in blocks 7 and 9; Moore Alley runs from Richmond to 8th (x ~2470-2483), and the ALLEY opposite it north of Richmond dead-ends (see 'ends'). HAVEN (block 9) and ALLEY (block 7) are printed along the alley at x ~3135-3146 from Richmond to 8th. The unnamed 10 ft E-W alley in block 9 (y ~3884) runs from Plum to Elm. East of Elm two alleys enter from the sheet 55 side; neither is named on this sheet. The one at y ~1680 (lines 1658/1700, 4 inch main) is the east part of Grandin Alley (named on sheet 55), offset about 160 px north of the west part at y 1840, so Elm has two Grandin T's. The one at y ~3976 (lines 3952/3999) is Andrews Alley (sheet 55), about 90 px south of the block 9 alley. Richmond (24'4") continues east of Elm as Carter Alley (sheet 55), hence the Elm/Richmond cross. At Elm and 8th the east side is Garfield Place (north line y 4320, about 70 px south of West 8th's north line). Its south line is off the paper, so the Elm/Garfield Place point (y 4540) assumes its 126 ft width from sheet 45 and is less certain than the others. Elm drifts from x ~3615 at the top to ~3600 at 8th (scan skew).
